_comment: Hand-maintained model card fields for the open-model report. Baked into data/open-models/models.json by scripts/open_models_bake.py; the UI hides any field left null. The bake seeds an entry automatically when a new run appears in data/open-model-analysis/ - fill in label / org / params / license / links, then re-bake.
_fieldSource: params / license / released read from the official Hugging Face model cards (checked 2026-09-16); 'activated parameters' only where the card itself states it. 'mode' is set only where the model name states it.

deepseek-vl2-small.label: DeepSeek-VL2-Small
deepseek-vl2-small.notes: Mixture-of-experts VLM built on DeepSeekMoE-16B (16,148,349,504 parameters); the model card states 2.8B activated parameters. Weights carry a custom DeepSeek licence, not an OSI one.

internvl3_5-8b.label: InternVL3.5-8B
internvl3_5-8b.notes: Dense vision-language model (InternVLChatModel, bf16, 8,528,318,464 parameters). Apache-2.0 per the official Hugging Face card.

kimi-vl-a3b-thinking.label: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking
kimi-vl-a3b-thinking.notes: Mixture-of-experts VLM; the card states the language decoder activates 2.8B parameters (16,407,657,776 total). This run is the original Thinking release, not the newer 2506 checkpoint.

molmo2-8b.label: Molmo2-8B
molmo2-8b.notes: Dense open vision-language model (8,661,703,120 parameters), Apache-2.0. Its model card links no paper.

pixtral-large-instruct-2411-hf-fp8-dynam.label: Pixtral Large 2411 (FP8)
pixtral-large-instruct-2411-hf-fp8-dynam.notes: Instruction-tuned Pixtral Large: 124,143,316,352 parameters, of which 121.8B are stored FP8_E4M3 — the FP8-dynamic build by Red Hat AI of mistralai/Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411. Weights carry the Mistral Research License, not an OSI licence. Its combination3d run covers 725 of 1,500 images (3,878 records missing), so per-domain comparisons for that domain rest on a smaller sample.

qwen3-vl-8b-instruct.label: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
qwen3-vl-8b-instruct.notes: Dense 8B vision-language model (8,767,123,696 parameters). Instruction mode: it answers directly, with no visible reasoning trace.

qwen3-vl-8b-thinking.label: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking
qwen3-vl-8b-thinking.notes: The same weights as the Instruct checkpoint, run in thinking mode: it emits a reasoning trace before its answer, which shows up in its parse-failure rate and its own scorer.
